text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Emir praises U.S. policy to maintain security and stability in the Gulf during meeting with former U.S. secretary of state James Baker.
- Industry ministry undersecretary discusses with Indian businessmen ways of promoting industrial investment.
- Bahrain's share index rises 37.15 point in one day, trading volume exceeds eight million shares.
- Bahrain to prepare a study on tourism in the island.
